decisions.reason: As the lead automation module in the firm's integrated precast plant concept, the combined shuttering and de-shuttering robot remains strategically important and is unlikely to be withdrawn soon.
The automatic de-shuttering robot still fills a useful modular and lower-investment position alongside the combined system, so it is worth keeping in the portfolio.
Although more specialized than the main production robots, the profile storage robot supports automated material flow and fits the firm's broad plant-solution offering.
This newly launched product line with several models extends the firm's established circulation and process equipment range and should be given time to build market traction.
Production analysis software strengthens the firm's move toward digital, future-ready precast production and complements its equipment, controls, and lifecycle support business.
